_about: Fictional promises for the migrant_text sample (migrant_my_contract.txt), used only when ledger.enabled is on. The agent, the phone number and the exchange rate are invented: the rate stands for one the user would type, never a rate Ain looks up.
note: The agency's man Mr Rahim Talukder told me this at the Naya Paltan office and again on the phone from 01812345678.
